text: The due-diligence file from June 2025 stating no loss was detected on the property is no longer valid. As of November 12, 2026, a tree-cover loss candidate of 13.5 ha was detected in 2025 within the asset. However, this change is pending corroboration and does not establish if the change is persistent, the cause of the change, or if it was legal or authorized. Further investigation is needed to confirm and understand the nature of this loss.
